verdicts.note: subspace-labels should not use q for the second bilinear-form vector; q is the volume shrink factor on subset-intersection-network. Use another letter such as v.
gaussian-dyadics should not use a for the real numerator part; a is the first scalar of the two-point kernel on complex-phase-network. Use another letter such as re or p.
gaussian-dyadics should not use b for the imaginary numerator part; b is the second scalar of the two-point kernel on complex-phase-network. Use another letter such as im or q.
discrete-fourier-transform should not use x for the input vector; x on radix-digit-convolution is the integer val(x). Use another letter such as z for the vector, or write the integer as val(x).
exact-integer-multiplication should not use x for the binary string; x on radix-digit-convolution is the integer val(x). Write the integer as val(x) or use another letter for the string.
exact-integer-multiplication should not use y for the binary string; y on radix-digit-convolution is the integer val(y). Write the integer as val(y) or use another letter for the string.
synthetic-transforms should not use p for the input vector of records; p on polynomial-ring-mod-yr-plus-1 is a power exponent. Use another letter such as z for the records.
synthetic-transforms should not use p for the input vector of records; p on polynomial-ring-convolution is the index offset i+j-k. Use another letter such as z for the records.
polynomial-ring-mod-yr-plus-1 should not use p for the power exponent; p on polynomial-ring-convolution is the index offset i+j-k. Use another letter such as e for the exponent.
subspace-labels should not use p for the first bilinear-form vector; p on guard-width-bound is the count of fractional bits. Use another letter such as u.
subspace-labels should not use L for a subspace label; L on packed-bit-addition is the chunk width, a bit count equal to mu times K. Use another letter such as W for the label.
subspace-labels should not use M for the larger label; M on packed-bit-addition is the record count. Use another letter such as N for the label.

prime-source-lengths should not use t for the padded axis length; t on cyclic-convolution is the number of entries in each sequence, any positive integer, while the padded axis length is a power of two. Use another letter such as T_nu for the padded axis length.
